# REMO World (https://remoworld.com)

> REMO World is a free bilingual (English & French) 4D City Social Network, Live World Radio Player (38 ad-free global & Lofi stations), Browser Geography Game ("Guess My City!"), and 9:16 Virtual Boarding Pass Generator connecting 24 world cities in real time.

## Key Free Features (Zero Sign-Up Required to Explore)
- [REMO World Live Social App](https://remoworld.com/): Real-time cross-city social feed, 1-click cross-city Waves with km distance, live City Clicker Cup wars, Citizen Passports, and collectible 4D City Cards.
- [Free Live World Cities Radio (38 Stations)](https://remoworld.com/world-radio.html): Stream live radio from Paris, Montréal, Chișinău, Bucharest, New York, London, Tokyo, Seoul, Berlin, Dubai + Lofi, Jazz & Synthwave with Listen-to-Earn coin rewards.
- [Guess The City Photo Game](https://remoworld.com/guess-the-city.html): Free browser geography & skyline photo guessing game created by real citizens worldwide.
- [4D Holographic Boarding Pass Generator](https://remoworld.com/boarding-pass.html): Create & download 9:16 Story Boarding Passes between any two world cities for TikTok, Instagram & WhatsApp.
- [All 24 Connected World Cities Directory](https://remoworld.com/cities/index.html): Live local time, weather, radio streams & urban stats for every Edition-1 metropolis.
